symptoms: The job fails with a security validation error rather than an authorization error
The job is configured for fine-grained access control, where AWS Glue isolates a system driver from the user driver
The system driver logs that would explain it are not readable: AWS Glue disables access to them on Lake Formation-enabled applications
likely_causes: AWS Glue detected a security validation error in the isolation between the system profile and the user profile. The AWS troubleshooting page does not enumerate the conditions that produce it
diagnostic_steps: Confirm the job declares fine-grained access control, because the system and user profile split only exists there

Inventory the functionality that AWS Glue blocks under fine-grained access control to preserve the isolation of the system driver: user-defined types, Hive UDFs, any user-defined function involving custom classes, custom data sources, additional jars for Spark extension, connector or metastore, and the ANALYZE TABLE command
Confirm the job uses a single Spark session throughout, which fine-grained access control requires
fixes: Remove the blocked functionality the job declares, when the inventory finds any
Contact AWS support. The AWS troubleshooting page prescribes exactly this for a security validation exception, and no self-service remediation is published
unsafe_fixes: Disabling fine-grained access control to make the error disappear, which removes the row, column and cell level controls the job was placed under: that is a governance decision, not a fix
Retrying the job on more workers, which does not touch the isolation the error is about
verification: There is no verification of a fix that AWS support has not yet described. What can be verified is the removal of blocked functionality: re-run and confirm the job reaches the read it was performing
rollback: Restore the removed functionality only together with a decision about the access model, because the blocked list is not a lacuna of the runtime, it is a boundary the platform declares
